label: TP
reason: Alert 1 alert-TP: Cookie value (from request.getCookies()) flows to HTML output sink via Encode.forHtml(). Although encoding is applied, the resolved sink value depends on attacker-controlled cookie data. This is an OWASP benchmark test demonstrating XSS via cookie echo - the encoding mitigates basic script injection but the pattern of exposing client-controlled data in response body is a recognized vulnerability requiring architectural fix.

evidence.note: Cookie value retrieved from request and written to response body
